retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white urban scene featuring dynamic motion blur and harsh directional lighting from street lamps.
triggerTerms: grainy black and white street action

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, monochromatic urban night scene capturing a group of figures in mid-motion on an asphalt street, characterized by heavy film grain, long directional shadows, and a bright overhead light source creating a hazy flare.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights
Dynamic diagonal composition created by the street and figures
Motion blur on limbs contrasting with sharper static backgrounds
Long, distorted shadows stretching toward the bottom left
coreInvariants: Visible light flare in the upper right quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central cluster of four figures interacting, occupying the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright street light flare in the top right corner acting as the primary light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal flow from the top right light source down through the figures to the long shadows in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive asphalt foreground and dark urban background providing breathing room for the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and asphalt
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for light flares and highlights on clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin tones and background textures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast with crushed blacks and blown-out highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying scales or weights for metadata blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, industrial look suitable for urban metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast black and white photo of people in motion on a city street at night under a bright street lamp with long shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, white, condensed sans-serif text block in the bottom right corner with a thin black border.

verificationChecks: Is there visible motion blur on the subjects?
Is the film grain texture prominent?
Is the light source flare visible in the upper right?

adjustableVariables: Brightness of the street light flare
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on clothing
Exact text content of the corner label
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'crushed' blacks in the shadows
Ensure the motion blur looks natural rather than a filter effect
Verify the light flare doesn't obscure the central action too much
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Night Motion = (High Contrast B&W + Heavy Film Grain) * (Directional Street Light + Motion Blur) / Diagonal Composition
